answer: Require every new agent to lock a 12 POA deposit and pass a proof-of-uptime test: a small juniper-like tree of three heartbeat signatures per epoch, each due within 40 seconds of a random beacon. A farm of 100 clones must lock 1,200 POA and sign 300 timed messages per epoch, while an honest sparrow-sized operator runs only one. Missing 4 beats in 10 epochs forfeits 30% of the deposit, so each opal-clear fake costs real capital and attention.
